To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
stacks of atomic layer deposited (ALD) Al2O3 and ZnO can be used for passivation of silicon as well as tunneling contacts.
the passivation of n‐type and p‐type Si by Al2 O 3/Zn O stacks, which can be used for tunneling contacts and heterojunctions, was investigated.
stacks with Al 2 O 3 thicknesses > 3 nm lead to low surface recombination velocities irrespective of Al-doped ZnO thickness and Al-doping.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the passivation of Si and the formation of tunneling contacts by Al2O 3/ ZnO stacks.
the passivation and tunnel junction formation by Al2Ox/ZnO stacks and the influence of the ZnO doping on these processes.
the investigation of the passivation properties of Al2O3 and Al2O3/ ZnO stacks on Si surfaces.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the passivation of silicon by Al2O-3/ZnO stack films can be improved by increasing the Al2O3 layer thickness, while maintaining a sufficient tunneling current density by increasing the ZnO layer thickness.
the passivation of Si is not affected by the presence of the Al2O3 layer in the stacks, but rather by the ZnO layer.
the passivation of Si is not significantly improved by the presence of a ZnO layer, but that the tunneling contact properties are.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ALD Al2O3 is an effective passivating film on n- and p-Si, but that the passivation of the ZnO layer is crucial for the overall performance of the stacks.
Al2O3 passivation of n‐Si is superior to Al2O3/Al‐ZnO passivation, while Al2O3 is less efficient in p‐Si passivation, and the passivation is further enhanced by the Al‐ZnO layer.
ALD Al2O3 passivation of Si is improved by ZnO and that the ZnO layer is required to be thicker than 1 nm.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the passivation of silicon by ALD Al2O3 can be enhanced by the addition of a thin ZnO layer, which is beneficial for tunneling contact formation.
Al2O3 can act as a tunneling contact on n-type Si and a heterojunction contact on p-type Si, while the ZnO layer can be used to improve the passivation quality.
the passivation of Si with Al2O 3/ZnO stack films is not only feasible but can also lead to passivation levels comparable to those achieved with single-layer Al 2O 3 films.
